items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Alvin Stoller has a newspaper clipping he took out that shows a Petrillo quote

ctx.x: You're talking about the leadership of the Musicians Union.

Yeah, the union leadership. They haven't been realistic. Like, it was blown way back in the days of Petrillo, when TV first came out. Alvin Stoller has a newspaper clipping he took out that shows a Petrillo quote that he really didn't believe that TV was going to last. That's a fact! He thought it was a gimmick. So consequently, the musicians' contract with the TV networks regarding filmed shows was ridiculous. We get nothing.
